name: Alphalete - Blog Batches 1 and 2 2026-06
body:
> Blog · Alphalete · 2026-06-12

Also: `wp-staging\` and `pdf_fulltext_dump.txt` (project root)

# Summary
The first two batches of Alphalete blog posts (5 + 5), delivered as PDFs, converted to staging HTML in `wp-staging\`, and created as WordPress drafts with wp-cli (author 3, category Articles, Yoast focus keyword, title and meta, since Yoast was the SEO plugin then). Most went live Jun 11 to 12 2026. `pdf_fulltext_dump.txt` is a plain-text extract of all 10 PDFs.

# Later history (per other files)
- The what-is post became the site's biggest impression source in August (57% of impressions, about position 23 nationally) and then fell from about 25 to about 70 after its Sep 16 rewrite. A title test decision was due Oct 2.
- Gurgling drains and cracked vs collapsed later got duplicate sister posts (12688 / 13469 and 12687 / 13468) flagged in the Jul 21 blog inventory.
- Blogs moved from root to `/blog/` on Jul 17 with 301s.
- Elementor fixes to these posts on Jun 12 are in [Alphalete - Blog Elementor Fixes 2026-06-12](lib:brain-alphalete-blog-elementor-fixes-2026-06-12).

# Files
- `Batch 1\1..5 of Batch 1.pdf`, `Batch 2\1..5 of Batch 2.pdf`: the delivered posts.
- `wp-staging\b1-*.html`, `b2-*.html`, `meta.json`: staging HTML and per-post SEO meta.
- `wp-staging\create_drafts.sh` / `.php`: draft-creation scripts (no note).
